task_description: Fix the More -> PDF Export Annual Report producing a blank (template-only, no data) PDF. Root cause: mgmt/backend/src/index.js convertDocxToPdfBulk handler forwards req.base64 (undefined) instead of req.data as the placeholder-set argument to dispatchBulkPdfConvert, so the Render pdf_convert job fills the report template with an empty object and every loop/scalar renders blank. Fix: forward req.data; add prove-first tests (handler wiring contract, Render-job data preservation, Render loop fill). Keep existing suites green. User must redeploy the mgmt Worker for the fix to take effect.
